checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-OPERATOR-PROVIDES-CHECKPOINT: WS checkpoint input validation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Provide malformed checkpoint strings via CLI (missing colon, non-hex characters, wrong-length root, negative epoch). 2. Supply a checkpoint with valid format but non-existent block root. 3. Supply a checkpoint with epoch exceeding current finalized epoch and verify block existence check. 4. Supply checkpoint with epoch <= finalized epoch and verify root matching. 5. Confirm client terminates with descriptive error on invalid checkpoints. 6. Test injection attacks through the checkpoint parameter (shell metacharacters, oversized input).
executable_checks: fuzzing: CLI checkpoint parameter with malformed format strings
unit_test: checkpoint parser rejects all invalid formats and returns specific error messages
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-WEAKSUB-PRECOND-001. Trust edge EDGE-OPERATOR-PROVIDES-CHECKPOINT from EXT-NODE-OPERATOR-CLI to CL Weak Subjectivity Checkpoint Validation. Format must be '0x<32-byte hex>:<epoch_number>'. Covers nodes: STATE-CLIENT-STARTING, ACTION-PARSE-WS-CHECKPOINT, STATE-WS-CHECKPOINT-PARSED.

checklist.title: Verify checkpoint parsing correctly separates block root and epoch after boundary crossing
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Provide valid checkpoint strings and verify parsed block root matches expected 32-byte value. 2. Verify parsed epoch number is correctly extracted as integer. 3. Test edge cases: epoch 0, maximum epoch value, root with all zeros, root with all 0xff. 4. Confirm parsed values are used correctly in subsequent canonical chain validation.
executable_checks: unit_test: parser output matches expected root and epoch for known-good inputs
property_test: roundtrip encoding/decoding preserves checkpoint values
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-WEAKSUB-PRECOND-001. Supporting node check for ACTION-PARSE-WS-CHECKPOINT. Verifies internal handling after data crosses trust boundary.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-ATTACKER-FORKS: long-range attack fork rejection
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Simulate a long-range attack by presenting a conflicting finalized checkpoint from an alternative chain history. 2. Verify the WS mechanism detects the conflicting checkpoint within the WS period. 3. Confirm the client rejects the attacker's fork and does not reorganize to it. 4. Verify that accepting the conflicting fork would require >= 1/3 of total stake to be slashable. 5. Test with forks at various depths relative to the WS checkpoint epoch.
executable_checks: integration_test: client rejects conflicting finalized checkpoints within WS period
simulation: long-range attack scenario with historical validator key compromise
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-WEAKSUB-PRECOND-003. Trust edge EDGE-ATTACKER-FORKS from EXT-LONG-RANGE-ATTACKER to CL Fork Choice and Finalization. Security assumption: conflicting finalized checkpoints require >= 1/3 slashable stake.

checklist.title: Verify fork detection logic correctly identifies conflicting checkpoint histories
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Create test scenarios with two conflicting finalized checkpoints at the same epoch. 2. Verify the fork choice implementation correctly identifies the conflict. 3. Test that EDGE-CONFLICTING-CHECKPOINTS triggers appropriate error handling. 4. Verify logging and alerting when conflicting checkpoints are detected.
executable_checks: unit_test: fork detection identifies conflicting checkpoints at same epoch
integration_test: alert mechanism fires on conflicting checkpoint detection
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-WEAKSUB-PRECOND-003. Supporting node check for ACTION-ATTACKER-CREATES-FORK. Verifies internal fork detection after boundary crossing.

checklist.title: Falsify precompile address range validation by calling addresses outside 0x01-0x09
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Call address 0x00 and verify it is NOT treated as a precompile. 2. Call address 0x0a and verify it triggers empty code execution emulation, not precompile logic. 3. Call addresses at the boundary (0x01, 0x09) and confirm precompile execution. 4. Call address 0x0000...0001 with leading zeros and verify correct handling. 5. Test with CREATE/CREATE2 targeting precompile addresses to verify they cannot be overwritten.
executable_checks: unit_test: address 0x00 and 0x0a bypass precompile dispatch
integration_test: boundary addresses 0x01 and 0x09 execute correct precompile
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP2003-PRECOND-002. Falsification target: ACTION-VALIDATE-DESTINATION. Related ambiguity: AMB-EIP2003-01. Attempting to bypass the EIP-1352 precompile range check.

checklist.title: Falsify out-of-gas post-condition by checking for residual gas or output leakage
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Call a precompile with gas_limit = gas_cost - 1 and verify EVMC_OUT_OF_GAS is returned. 2. Verify remaining gas is exactly 0 (not negative or underflowed). 3. Verify no output data is returned in the out-of-gas case. 4. Check for unexpected side effects (storage writes, logs) that may persist despite OOG. 5. Test with gas_limit = 0 for edge case behavior.
executable_checks: unit_test: precompile returns EVMC_OUT_OF_GAS with zero gas and empty output on insufficient gas
property_test: no side effects persist after out-of-gas precompile call
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP2003-POSTCOND-002. Falsification target: STATE-OUT-OF-GAS. Verifying side-effects and checking for unexpected state changes on gas exhaustion.

checklist.title: Falsify Fusaka fork ID invariant by verifying incorrect fork identifier values
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Activate Fusaka fork at the configured block/timestamp and read the resulting fork identifier. 2. Verify it matches the expected network-specific value (0x5167e2a6 for Mainnet). 3. Test on each supported network (Mainnet, Sepolia, Holesky) and verify each has correct fork ID. 4. Attempt state transition across Fusaka activation boundary and verify fork ID changes atomically. 5. Verify EIP-2124 compatibility by checking fork ID is correctly included in ENR and devp2p handshake.
executable_checks: unit_test: fork ID equals 0x5167e2a6 after Fusaka activation on Mainnet
integration_test: devp2p handshake uses updated fork ID post-Fusaka
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-EIP7607-INV-002. Falsification target: ACTION-UPDATE-FORK-ID. Attempting to violate the fork ID update invariant through state transitions across activation boundary.

checklist.title: Falsify identity precompile gas linearity invariant with varying input sizes
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Call identity precompile with inputs of size 0, 1, 31, 32, 33, 64, 1024, and max_input_size bytes. 2. Record gas consumed for each call and compute gas-per-word ratio. 3. Verify the ratio is constant (linear scaling). 4. Check for integer overflow in word count calculation with very large inputs (e.g., 2^256-1 bytes). 5. Verify gas cost formula: base_cost + word_cost * ceil(input_size / 32). 6. Test that no sub-linear gas cost allows resource amplification.
executable_checks: property_test: gas_cost(n) - gas_cost(n-32) == word_cost for all n > 32
unit_test: word count calculation does not overflow for maximum input size
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-IDENTITY-INV-002. Falsification target: ACTION-COMPUTE-TOTAL-GAS. Related assumption: ASSUM-PRAGUE-IDENTITY-02. Testing linearity of gas scaling to prevent resource amplification.

checklist.title: Falsify ISZERO stack depth invariant by observing net stack change != 0
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Push a known number of values onto the stack, execute ISZERO, and verify stack depth is unchanged. 2. Test with stack containing exactly 1 element (minimum for ISZERO). 3. Test with empty stack and verify proper stack underflow error. 4. Verify the result is 1 when input is 0 and 0 when input is non-zero. 5. Test with input values: 0, 1, 2^255, 2^256-1 (max uint256). 6. Execute ISZERO in a loop and verify stack depth remains stable.
executable_checks: unit_test: stack depth before ISZERO == stack depth after ISZERO for all valid inputs
unit_test: ISZERO on empty stack returns stack underflow error
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-ISZERO-INV-001. Falsification target: ACTION-POP-VALUE-FOR-ZERO-CHECK. Testing net stack depth change of 0 (1 pop, 1 push).

checklist.title: Falsify column reconstruction metrics post-condition by checking counter and histogram
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Trigger column reconstruction and capture beacon_data_availability_reconstructed_columns_total before and after. 2. Verify counter is incremented by exactly the number of columns reconstructed. 3. Verify reconstruction_time_seconds histogram records a non-zero elapsed time. 4. Test that failed reconstruction does not increment the success counter. 5. Check for metric label correctness (column index, result status). 6. Verify metrics are exported correctly via Prometheus endpoint.
executable_checks: integration_test: counter increments by correct amount after column reconstruction
integration_test: histogram records positive duration for reconstruction
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-METRICS-POSTCOND-003. Falsification target: ACTION-RECONSTRUCT-COLUMNS. Verifying side-effects: counter increment and histogram recording.

checklist.title: Falsify ModExp minimum gas floor by finding inputs that produce gas cost < 200
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Call ModExp with minimal inputs (base=0, exp=0, mod=1, all lengths=1) and verify gas cost >= 200. 2. Call with all-zero length fields and verify gas cost >= 200. 3. Call with empty input (zero-length calldata) and verify gas cost >= 200. 4. Fuzz the gas calculation formula with edge-case inputs targeting sub-200 results. 5. Verify the minimum is applied AFTER the full gas formula computation, not before. 6. Check for integer underflow in gas calculation that could wrap around the floor.
executable_checks: property_test: gas_cost >= 200 for all valid ModExp inputs
unit_test: minimum gas floor applied after formula computation
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-MODEXP-INV-001. Falsification target: ACTION-APPLY-MINIMUM. Related assumption: ASSUM-EIP2565-03. DoS mitigation via minimum gas cost of 200.

checklist.title: Falsify ModExp result correctness by comparing against reference implementation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Compute base^exponent mod modulus for known test vectors and compare against precompile output. 2. Verify result is zero-padded to exactly modulus_length bytes. 3. Test edge cases: modulus=1 (result should be 0), exponent=0 (result should be 1 mod m), base=0. 4. Test with large values (256-byte base, exponent, modulus). 5. Verify result when modulus_length > actual modulus byte length (leading zeros in modulus). 6. Cross-reference with Python pow(base, exp, mod) or OpenSSL BIGNUM for correctness.
executable_checks: differential_test: precompile output vs Python pow(base, exp, mod) for 1000 random inputs
unit_test: result is zero-padded to modulus_length bytes
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-MODEXP-POSTCOND-001. Falsification target: STATE-RESULT-COMPUTED. Verifying mathematical correctness and output padding.

checklist.title: Falsify WS safety margin invariant by finding states where margin drops below 23.3%
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Compute the WS period for various validator set sizes and verify the safety margin formula: 1/3 - SAFETY_DECAY/100. 2. Simulate validator exits reducing active stake and verify the safety margin is recalculated correctly. 3. Test with SAFETY_DECAY at boundary values (0, 100, max). 4. Verify that when the WS period expires, the client correctly identifies it is outside the safe window. 5. Test with validator set sizes at the minimum (MIN_PER_EPOCH_CHURN_LIMIT boundary) to find edge cases. 6. Verify the invariant holds across epoch transitions.
executable_checks: property_test: safety_margin >= (1/3 - SAFETY_DECAY/100) for all states within WS period
simulation: validator exit scenarios maintaining margin above threshold
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W1-WEAKSUB-INV-001. Falsification target: STATE-SAFETY-MARGIN-INTACT. Related assumption: ASSUM-WEAKSUB-02. Testing the ~23.3% safety margin invariant.
